sources.title: Clownstein/Black-Onyx - GitHub
sources.snippet: Black Onyx is an invite-only threat-intelligence workspace (TIP-first) for blue-team investigation, with an absorbed detection spine (Kafka/Postgres anomaly pipeline, incidents, hunt, SOAR). It is not a SIEM replacement: it helps analysts ingest evidence, work IOCs, triage alerts and connector detections, correlate multi-model findings into incidents, manage cases and assets, and measure ...
